{"bash_command":"git","full_command":"git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(client): add failing tests for CLI framework (Story 6.1)

RED phase: comprehensive integration tests covering all 10 ACs.
Tests fail to compile because the CLI modules don't exist yet.

- AC-1: Top-level command groups (query, rules, alerts, etc.)
- AC-2: Subcommand help rendering for all commands
- AC-3: Exit codes (0/1/2/3/4) via CliError::exit_code()
- AC-4: Output formatting (table/json/csv) with ResponseMetadata
- AC-5: Global flags (-v, --quiet, --server, --format, --no-color)
- AC-6: Clap derive macros compile-time assertions
- AC-7: SiemClient header injection and HTTP error mapping
- AC-8: Config loading from TOML with env var overrides
- AC-9: Shell completion (bash/zsh/fish/powershell)

Also fixes pre-existing test quality issues in axiathon-core:
- Fix vacuous || assertion to && in error_not_found test
- Remove tautological result_type_alias and error_propagation tests
- Add missing limit/offset assertions to api_meta_all_fields_optional
- Add error variant check to tenant_id_new_rejects_too_long
- Rename misleading clone_is_independent to clone_equals_original
- Strengthen time-ordering tests with batch generation
EOF
)"","description":"Commit failing tests for Story 6.1"}
